issues.description:
Method return type inconsistency for Animal.messageOnFeed():
- Problem statement/UML declares Animal.messageOnFeed() as returning String (problem_statement.md, UML abstract method). The Part 2 task examples also show messageOnFeed() returning string values for Seal/Pig/Goat.
- In the solution, Animal.java declares the method as "public abstract FeedResponse messageOnFeed();" (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Animal.java: line 18). A new class FeedResponse is introduced (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/FeedResponse.java). Concrete classes are inconsistent: Seal.java and Pig.java implement messageOnFeed() returning FeedResponse (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Seal.java and Pig.java), while Goat.java implements messageOnFeed() returning String (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Goat.java). Farm.feedAllAnimals() in the solution calls System.out.println(a.messageOnFeed()), relying on the return type to be printable (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java).
This mismatch (String vs FeedResponse) between the specification and the solution -- and the inconsistent signatures among concrete classes -- will confuse students and causes a real compilation/override problem (Goat's String return does not override Animal's FeedResponse signature).
issues.suggestedFix:
Make the messageOnFeed() return type consistent across all artifacts. Two viable, explicit choices:
1) Align to the problem statement (recommended if following UML/text): change Animal.messageOnFeed() to return String in solution (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Animal.java) and update Seal.java and Pig.java to return String (remove FeedResponse class if unused). Ensure Farm.feedAllAnimals() and sing logic print the String results directly. Update any tests or documentation accordingly.
2) If FeedResponse is intended, update the problem statement and UML to state that messageOnFeed() returns FeedResponse and document the FeedResponse fields/behavior; then update Goat.java to return FeedResponse and adjust example outputs in the task text to reflect FeedResponse semantics. Ensure Farm.feedAllAnimals() and sing logic handle FeedResponse (e.g., use FeedResponse.toString() or getMessage()).
Either fix must ensure all concrete implementations (Seal, Pig, Goat), the Animal abstract signature, sample code (Main/Farm), and the problem statement/UML are consistent.
